data.one_liner: Database-agnostic, offline-first sync engine for Dart and Flutter
data.what_it_does: sync_pilot orchestrates optimistic local CRUD, outbox compaction, temporary ID mapping, 3‑way conflict resolution, and delta sync between any local store and any backend. It emits reactive streams for UI updates.
use_when: You need offline-first sync without locking into a specific database or backend
You want automatic outbox compaction and temporary ID handling
You need field‑level conflict resolution and delta pagination
avoid_when: You only need simple local persistence
You already use a dedicated backend sync solution like Firebase Realtime Database or Supabase's built‑in sync
strengths: Supports any local store (SQLite, Drift, Hive, SharedPreferences, in‑memory) and any backend (REST, GraphQL, gRPC, Firebase, Supabase, etc.)
Built‑in optimistic CRUD, outbox compaction, and temporary ID mapping
weaknesses: No built‑in UI widgets or form helpers
Requires manual configuration of adapters for each storage/transport
Learning curve for setting up conflict resolvers and adapters
data.setup_notes: Add sync_pilot to pubspec, create SyncPilotEngine with localStore and remoteAdapter, implement ConflictResolver, no build_runner needed

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides built‑in local persistence and optional sync via drift's built‑in sync features

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need local SQLite storage without sync

alternatives.name: flutter_secure_storage
alternatives.why_pick_it: For secure key‑value storage, not sync

data.minimal_example:
```dart
final engine = SyncPilotEngine<Todo>(
  entityName: 'todos',
  getId: (t) => t.id,
  toJson: (t) => t.toJson(),
  fromJson: Todo.fromJson,
  localStore: InMemorySyncStore<Todo>(getId: (t) => t.id),
  conflictResolver: ConflictResolver<Todo>.fieldLevelMerge(
    fromJson: Todo.fromJson,
  ),
  remoteAdapter: CallbackRemoteSyncAdapter<Todo>(
    onPush: (op) async => const PushOperationResult.success(),
    onPullDelta: (cp) async => const RemoteDeltaPage<Todo>(
      upserted: [],
      deletedIds: [],
      nextCheckpoint: '2026-11-07T12:00:00Z',
      hasMore: false,
    ),
  ),
);
```
